events.title: Summer Sealed League
events.description: Six weeks of sealed league play kicking off this summer. Build your pool, earn prizes, and trade between rounds.

events.title: Vintage Card Night
events.description: Bring your old binders! A dedicated evening for Base Set, Jungle, Fossil, and early era collectors to trade and show off their collections.

events.title: Prerelease Weekend
events.description: Get your hands on the new set before anyone else. Prerelease packs, promos, and prizes up for grabs all weekend.

events.title: Regional Qualifier
events.description: Competitive players — this is your chance. Standard format, best-of-three, with Regional Championship invites on the line.

events.title: Draft & Trade Night
events.description: Pack draft, then open trading for the rest of the night. Great way to fill holes in your collection without spending a fortune.

events.title: End of Summer Invitational
events.description: Invite-only tournament for our top regulars, with an open side event for everyone else. Huge prize pool, vendor area, and a live pack opening stream.
